newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products mixed -- some weak, others strong.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products mixed -- some weak, others strong.

text.p: NWE oil products were mixed on Monday, with gasoline and fuel oil weaker but naphtha higher.
Gasoline was softer as NYMEX unleaded fell sharply. Eurograde barges traded at $200 fob ARA.
On naphtha, a trader was reported to be buying an Egyptian cargo at $216 cif NWE, the highest level since the Gulf War.
Gas oil was firm on futures and steady premiums, although traders said both the barge and the cargo markets were quiet.
High sulphur barges were about $5 lower, trading at $109 fob ARA as weaker swaps and the threat of Russian straight run overwhelmed bullish talk of tightness. -- +44 171 542 8980
